[SWS_CM_10272] Byte order of length field for strings
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00201, RS_CM_00202, RS_CM_00211
⌈
The length field, inserted in front of the serialized string, shall be encoded in network
byte order (big endian), as specified by [PRS_SOMEIP_00759].
